players.product: RockBlock modular natural-gas generator systems (designed, assembled, installed and operated turnkey with Granite software) for on-site bridge / prime and backup power at AI data centers

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: remaining performance obligations for power system sales installation services and associated ongoing services were approximately $1.8 billion at June 30, 2026, a significant portion expected to be recognized over the next one to two years. Contracted Power System Sales Backlog of approximately $1.7 billion rose $1.5 billion from June 30, 2025; substantially all of the year-over-year growth came from contracts with data center customers (partially offset by net reductions in utility and C&I backlog), geographically driven predominantly by projects in Texas, and most new contracts reflect expected delivery within 12 to 18 months. Based on Titan capacity and the anticipated commencement of operations at the Hyperion facility in the second half of 2026, ERock expects to execute the backlog over approximately two years. Management expects total cost of revenues to rise with revenue over that period but revenues to grow faster than costs, improving margins compared to 2025 levels, driven by operational efficiencies from the Titan and Hyperion facilities, installation cost improvements from standardizing and pre-configuring RockBlock systems, and the largely fixed-cost O&M infrastructure; it lists component or raw material cost increases, supply chain disruptions, labor cost increases and Hyperion startup delays or costs as risks to that improvement.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO approximately $1.8 billion; backlog approximately $1.7 billion (+$1.5 billion YoY); backlog execution over approximately two years

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q operating metrics at June 30, 2026: Annualized Recurring Service Revenue $23,601 thousand versus $20,047 thousand a year earlier (+17.7%); installed base 1,104 MW versus 979 MW (+12.8%).
quarterly_data.figure: installed base 1,104 MW (+12.8%); Annualized Recurring Service Revenue $23,601 thousand (+17.7%)
